name: real_world_benchmark_v1
description: Mixed-domain benchmark for comparing classic vector RAG with Intentmind associative recall.

memories.text: The car insurance renewal is due next month, and I need to compare prices before paying.
The mechanic said the front brake pads are worn and should be replaced before a long trip.
I parked the car in garage level B2 near the blue elevator.
The fuel gauge dropped quickly on the highway, so I noted a possible fuel leak.
The annual vehicle inspection expires on June 10.
I keep the spare key in the small drawer by the kitchen door.
The tire pressure warning appeared after the cold morning drive.
The service appointment is booked with Northside Auto for Friday morning.
I need to update roadside assistance because the old plan expired.
The car registration document is in the black folder with tax papers.
The Antalya hotel reservation is confirmed for July 14.
I saved the Istanbul office address as the first stop after landing.
For the London trip, passport renewal must be checked before booking flights.
The airport shuttle leaves from gate 4 at 6 AM.
I prefer aisle seats on long flights because my knee gets stiff.
The family beach plan in Antalya depends on renting a larger car.
I stored the train ticket QR code in the travel folder.
The Berlin conference hotel is close to the museum district.
The suitcase lock code is 4820.
The travel insurance policy covers medical emergencies abroad.
My dentist appointment is on Monday at 3 PM for the cracked filling.
The doctor recommended checking blood pressure every morning for two weeks.
I felt dizzy after skipping breakfast and drinking too much coffee.
The allergy pills are in the bathroom cabinet next to the thermometer.
I should avoid peanuts because they triggered a mild allergic reaction last time.
The physical therapist gave me shoulder mobility exercises.
The running shoes caused knee pain after the 10K practice.
I need to refill the thyroid medicine before the weekend.
The sleep tracker showed poor sleep after late screen time.
I logged the migraine after eating very salty snacks.
The Alpha project deadline moved to May 28 because legal review is delayed.
Sara owns the API contract review for the payments integration.
The client wants a weekly status summary every Friday afternoon.
The design review decided to remove the animated onboarding screen.
The hiring panel prefers senior backend candidates with distributed systems experience.
The Q3 roadmap includes memory benchmark hardening and public documentation.
The security audit flagged missing rate limiting on the login endpoint.
The team agreed that GraphRAG is useful for document topology, not the main memory runtime.
The invoice approval workflow needs a fallback when the manager is on vacation.
The product demo should emphasize explainable recall paths rather than generic AI claims.
The cloud bill jumped because the image generation endpoint was left enabled.
The annual accounting software subscription renews on August 1.
I need to cancel the unused analytics tool before the trial becomes paid.
The grocery budget is tight this month after the car repair.
The tax receipt folder contains the vehicle registration payment.
The bank card ending in 9142 is attached to the hosting provider.
The freelance invoice for March is still unpaid by the agency.
I set a savings goal for the London trip.
The insurance quote was cheaper when bundled with roadside assistance.
The refund for the cancelled flight should arrive within five business days.
The washing machine makes a loud noise during the spin cycle.
The kitchen sink leaks under the left pipe after heavy use.
The landlord asked for photos of the balcony crack.
The spare light bulbs are in the hallway closet.
The neighbor has the apartment key for next weekend.
The electricity meter reading must be submitted before the 25th.
The new desk chair should arrive at the apartment lobby tomorrow.
The emergency water shutoff valve is behind the bathroom panel.
The storage box with old cables is under the guest bed.
The apartment Wi-Fi router password is written inside the white notebook.
The API rate limiter uses a token bucket with a 60 request per minute default.
The FAISS index is optional and should not be a hard dependency.
The benchmark runner should report median latency because single runs fluctuate.
The extractor must preserve user language and avoid invented concepts.
The recall trace should show called_by, path, layer, and edge confidence.
The JSON persistence loader rebuilds the intent index after loading saved memory.
The UI graph view uses local vis-network assets from the lib folder.
The LangChain adapter exposes Intentmind as a retriever component.
The FakeEmbedder is only for deterministic tests, not public benchmark claims.
The prompt builder includes a cognitive field section when recall activates related intents.
A movie review praised a car chase scene for its camera work.
The insurance company stock rose after quarterly earnings.
A cooking blog compared pasta shapes for thick sauces.
The word token appears in a board game rulebook about turn order.
A travel magazine ranked beaches without discussing personal reservations.
The gym replaced old treadmills with newer screens.
A cloud-shaped lamp was added to the showroom display.
The finance podcast discussed macroeconomic inflation trends.
An article about Berlin history mentioned museum architecture.
The login page mockup used a blue gradient background.

queries.query: Before the long drive tomorrow, what car maintenance or paperwork should I check?
queries.expected_reason: A car trip should activate service, inspection, brakes, and insurance neighbors.

queries.query: Where did I park the vehicle near the blue elevator?
Why did the highway drive make me worry about fuel?
queries.expected_reason: Fuel issue linked to the car highway memory.

queries.query: I need the spare key before taking the car, where is it?
What dashboard warning appeared after the cold drive?
queries.expected_reason: Cold drive should map to tire pressure warning.

queries.query: Which car help plan expired and was related to bundled insurance discounts?
queries.expected_reason: Roadside assistance bridges car operations and insurance finance.

queries.query: Where are the vehicle registration and tax payment papers?
queries.expected_reason: Registration document and tax receipt are related but stored in different chunks.

queries.query: For the Antalya family beach plan, what reservation and car dependency do I have?
queries.expected_reason: Antalya activates hotel and beach/rental-car memories.

queries.query: Before booking the London flights, what document and savings item should I remember?
queries.expected_reason: London links travel document and finance planning.

queries.query: What did I note about travel medical coverage abroad?
Which shuttle and gate matter for the early airport ride?
Where did I store the train ticket QR code?
Why should I choose an aisle seat on a long flight?
queries.expected_reason: Aisle seat is connected to knee stiffness.

queries.query: After landing in Istanbul, what is the first destination?
Where is the Berlin conference hotel located?
What is the suitcase lock code?
Which appointment is related to my cracked tooth filling?
What morning check did the doctor recommend for two weeks?
Why did I feel dizzy after coffee?
queries.expected_reason: Dizziness connected to skipping breakfast and coffee.

queries.query: Where are the allergy pills and thermometer?
Which food should I avoid because of the reaction?
What exercises did physical therapy give for my shoulder?
Why did the 10K practice hurt my knee?
queries.expected_reason: Knee pain connected to running shoes.

queries.query: Which medicine must be refilled before the weekend?
What late habit ruined my sleep tracker score?
queries.expected_reason: Sleep issue connected to screen time.

queries.query: What snack note was connected to the migraine?
What changed about the Alpha deadline and legal review?
Who owns the payments API contract review?
What weekly update does the client want?
What did design decide about animated onboarding?
What does the Q3 memory benchmark roadmap need to report?
queries.expected_reason: Roadmap item links to benchmark runner methodology.

queries.query: What security issue exists on the login endpoint and which implementation pattern helps?
queries.expected_reason: Security audit links to rate limiter implementation.

queries.query: How should the demo position GraphRAG and explainable recall?
queries.expected_reason: Positioning combines GraphRAG distinction and product demo message.

queries.query: What invoice workflow fallback is needed when someone is away?
Why did the cloud bill increase?
Which software subscription and paid trial should I manage?
queries.expected_reason: Subscription management spans renewal and cancellation.

queries.query: Why is the grocery budget tight this month?
queries.expected_reason: Budget issue linked to car repair.

queries.query: Which bank card pays for hosting?
Which March freelance payment is still missing?
When should the cancelled flight refund arrive?
Which appliance makes noise during the spin cycle?
Where is the sink leaking?
What photos did the landlord request?
Where are the spare light bulbs?
Where is the emergency water shutoff?
Why should FAISS remain optional in the project?
What must the extractor avoid when reading user text?
What fields should the recall trace expose?
What does JSON persistence rebuild after loading?
Why is FakeEmbedder not enough for public benchmark claims?
I need to prepare for a long road trip — what car, health, and travel items should I check?
queries.expected_reason: Cross-domain: car maintenance + travel safety + medicine refill all relevant before a trip.

queries.query: What's the connection between the car repair bill and my monthly budget?
queries.expected_reason: Cross-domain: finance chunk references car repair as the cause of budget pressure.

queries.query: Before the Friday service appointment, what else happens on Friday?
queries.expected_reason: Temporal cross-domain: Friday links car service and work status update.

queries.query: What home and car emergencies have specific locations I should remember?
queries.expected_reason: Cross-domain: emergency locations span home and car domains.

queries.query: Which documents are stored together in folders?
queries.expected_reason: Cross-domain: physical storage locations bridge car, finance, and travel.

queries.query: What health issues might affect my ability to drive or fly?
queries.expected_reason: Cross-domain: health conditions affect both driving (dizziness) and flying (knee).

queries.query: Which passwords and codes do I need to remember?
queries.expected_reason: Cross-domain: security codes span travel and home.

queries.query: What rate limiting pattern relates to both the security audit and the API design?
queries.expected_reason: Cross-domain: work security issue connects to dev implementation pattern.

queries.query: The doctor said I should walk more — does my commute or car use relate?
queries.expected_reason: Cross-domain: health recommendation connects to exercise/mobility issues.

queries.query: What items from different areas of my life need attention before the end of this month?
queries.expected_reason: Cross-domain: deadline-driven items across home, car, health, and finance.
